title: La Sobremesa: el final
description: docs/quests/universidad.md § Ending. After the fight: La Sobremesa comes apart at the long table and leaves the seven standing round it; the photo with the melon; their five lights go into Gerard and Aitor in turn, a beat apart; a spiral opens behind the table and everyone comes apart into it, born on their real surfaces (src/surface-samples.ts); out of a spiral on the November beach, each body coming together, the seven round the two of them, facing them. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: La Sobremesa comes apart at the long table; the seven are left round it
Free, round the melon table, facing Gerard and Aitor
Their five lights, a beat apart, into Gerard and Aitor in turn; a spiral opens behind the table and everyone comes apart into it, from their real surface
Out on the November beach: each body comes together out of specks, and the spiral closes
The seven round Gerard and Aitor, facing them
